definitions.explanation: The protrusion at the front of the throat formed by the thyroid cartilage of the larynx. More prominent in males.

examples.japanese: ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{喉仏|のどぼとけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: Men have a larger Adam's apple.

examples.japanese: {喉仏|のどぼとけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上下|じょうげ}→上下：04282_jouge⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I could see the Adam's apple moving up and down.

examples.japanese: {声変|こえが}わり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{喉仏|のどぼとけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧。
examples.english: The Adam's apple becomes more prominent after the voice breaks.

notes:
The Japanese term {喉仏|のどぼとけ} literally means "throat Buddha," referring to the resemblance of the cartilage to a seated Buddha figure.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese Buddhist cremation, the {喉仏|のどぼとけ} bone (the second cervical vertebra) is considered special because its shape resembles a Buddha in meditation. It is often the last bone picked up with chopsticks during bone-picking ceremonies.
